what: GET /v1/calls/{id} for a call the provider declined three seconds after it started dialling
source: observed against the live REST API on 2026-08-20, the second of two attempts that failed the same way. Identifiers, phone numbers and spoken names are synthetic; the shape and every field that carries a finding are as observed.
unobserved: task was dropped: it is the text Ringdown sent. The carrier's own reason is not exposed anywhere in this body; the call never reached the destination network, which was confirmed out of band against the Twilio account that owns the number
why_it_matters: the first REST call body ever observed. It settles two things the fake could only assume: metadata comes back exactly as sent, so the attempt identity check can pass, and each attempt carries a provider_call_id. It also records that failure_message says 'Hangup by: user' for a call of zero seconds that no carrier ever saw
